acceptance: The tracked v1 JSON Schema is strict, versioned, declares additionalProperties=false at object boundaries, and constrains transformation/status values.

The validator rejects malformed or non-UTF8 JSON, duplicate object keys, symlink inputs, oversized input, unsafe repository-relative paths, ambiguous source identity, invalid revisions/digests, and invalid prepared/imported lifecycle combinations.
Conformance tests prove valid prepared/imported records and deterministic failure for adversarial negative fixtures without adding third-party dependencies.
A dedicated Provenance CI job runs validator tests and repository validation from a fresh checkout while existing JS/TS, Rust, SpecGrain, and Diffcipline jobs remain green.
The exact candidate receives Diffcipline R2 PASS plus provenance-specific proof, imports zero donor source, and post-merge main preserves all required gates.

minimality.rationale: Use JSON Schema 2020-12 plus Python 3.11 standard-library parsing and the existing repository governance runtime; add no package or runtime dependency.

requirements: The validator must never execute manifest content or follow symlinks.
Reject duplicate keys, unsafe paths, oversized records, ambiguous source identity, and incomplete imported-state evidence deterministically.

outcome: Kernux has a machine-readable donor import manifest v1 contract and deterministic validator that fails closed on ambiguous or unsafe provenance records.

risk.recovery: Revert the bounded provenance-contract PR; no donor code or product/user runtime state exists yet.

scope_in: Define a strict JSON Schema 2020-12 v1 contract for donor source identity, authorization, licensing, source-to-destination mappings, transformation class, dependency review, characterization evidence, and import state.
Implement a deterministic dependency-free Python validator for tracked provenance manifests that never executes manifest content and fails closed on malformed, ambiguous, or unsafe records.

Add conformance and negative-path tests covering duplicate keys, malformed/non-UTF8 input, symlinks, oversized input, unsafe repository paths, source-identity ambiguity, transformation/lifecycle errors, and deterministic diagnostics.
Add a dedicated Provenance CI job that runs validator tests and validates every tracked donor manifest from a fresh checkout.
Document the machine-readable provenance location and enforcement workflow without importing donor source.
scope_out: No Orca, TinyFish, AgentQL, Desktop Commander, or other donor source import.
No third-party notices/license inventory implementation or donor import checklist; KX-P00-S04-T02 remains separate.
No Kernux project-license decision, dependency addition, product implementation, or P01 contract work.
title: KX-P00-S04-T01 — Establish donor provenance manifest v1 contract and validator
